attr.title: Jazz² Resurrection
attr.desc: Jazz² Resurrection is an open-source reimplementation of Jazz Jackrabbit 2 with enhanced graphics, local split-screen and online multiplayer, and support for custom levels and episodes. Requires original game files, Shareware Demo is enough to try it out.
attr.inst: Copy the contents of the original Jazz Jackrabbit 2 directory to "ports/jazz2/Source/". Game cache is created on the first launch.
attr.inst_md:
Copy the contents of the original *Jazz Jackrabbit 2* directory to `ports/jazz2/Source/`. Game cache is created on the first launch, which can take a while.

Supported releases are Shareware Demo, v1.20/1.23, Holiday Hare '98, The Secret Files and The Christmas Chronicles. To combine more of them, copy them over each other in this order, replacing existing files.
